name: Petit taxis
note: Fixed short routes around town for a few dirhams (~5 MAD base). Agree the fare before longer rides.

name: Grand taxi day hire
note: For the gorge, Dades Valley, and villages. Agree the full-day rate before departure; splitting with other travelers is normal.

name: CTM / Supratours station
note: Intercity buses leave from the town station. Book a day ahead in spring and autumn.

name: Pharmacies
note: Day pharmacies open roughly 09–21h on Avenue Mohammed V; nights are on call — ask your hotel or any pharmacy door sign.

name: Todra Gorge travel info
note: Local team for accommodation and travel arrangements around the gorge (published contact).
